source_context: The supplied transcription recheck discussion proposes manual image-to-text review and notes that LP2-00–02 were privately checked. Separately, the public boundary inventory identifies 32 rune-to-rune edges among LP2-00–55's 55 page breaks, without deciding if those are words. This test bounds the effect of that unresolved parsing choice on a published word-internal affine observation.
input_pages: text/lp2-00.txt through text/lp2-55.txt in numerical order, archived raw layer only
token_rule: Split on hyphen and period; slash and newline are layout markers and do not split words. Keep only the 29 stored runes; carry punctuation only as delimiters. The two variants differ only in whether a page break forces a split.
exclusions: No image adjudication of intended word joins; no new frequency null model, cipher identification, or correction of the archived transcription.
